name: Наварро — проникновение через ворота (пароль «Овечья голова»; не журнальный гейт)
_maps_note: Map 109 = navarro 'Navarro Entrance' (maps.txt) — Chris (the fuel pumps), the sentry (the gate) and Dornan (the parade ground) are all on the one map; mvar 0/14 live in its map-globals. There is no teleport anywhere in the chain — the player walks in on foot through the woods.

npcs._giver_note: ccchris = Chris the refueller (the Enclave's unofficial gatekeeper: he hands out the password and sets mvar0=1 through Node997). ccgguard = the sentry at the gate (mvar14=2 through the vanilla write in Node007; on our side, the atom's map_var form). ccdrill = Sergeant Dornan (the consumer of mvar0: the recruit branch instead of 'civilian -> alert').

brief: Проникновение на базу Наварро под видом новобранца: убедить Криса-заправщика, что ты из пополнения (проверка Красноречия; он вносит в списки — mvar0=1 — и выдаёт пароль «SHEEPSHEAD»/«ОВЕЧЬЯ ГОЛОВА»), затем ОДНОМУ подойти к часовому и назвать пароль (mvar14=2, «доложитесь начальнику строевой подготовки»). Записи в Пип-Бое нет — это гейт-цепочка, не журнальный квест. Тревога на базе (gvar 511>0) закрывает оба звена.

stages._src: gvar 511 == 0: the base alert is NOT raised — both gatekeepers behave normally (Chris screens the player, the sentry checks the password).

gvar 511 >= 1 (GVAR_NAVARRO_BASE_ALERT, written by CCGGUARD Node998 @0x2f74 and kin): the base is on alert — talk_p_proc in both scripts branches into the alert nodes, and neither the enlistment nor the password is offered. 'done' here = the gate chain closed by the alert (the record's terminal state, not a reward).

_guard_gvars_note: gvar 511 = GVAR_NAVARRO_BASE_ALERT (VAULT13.GAM:520): CCCHRIS talk_p_proc at 511>0 -> Node026 (alert float + hostile), CCGGUARD -> Node012+Node998. Both atoms guard on gvar(511)==0 — under an alert there is neither enlistment nor password.
_mapvars_note: mvar 0 (Map 109) = 'Chris enlisted you' — SOLE writer CCCHRIS Node997 (our atom calls it with exec_proc; mvar0 is NOT replicated). mvar 14 = 'the sentry let you through' — vanilla writer Node007 (=2); our atom writes it in map_var form, setmapvar=14:2 (Node007 is gsay-unsafe). The atom guards read both (guard_mapvars); the effect whitelist permits writing only 14 (effect_mapvars). NB: the mvar whitelists are flat (no map scope) — cross-map index collisions are neutralized by the atoms' scope.script binding (ccchris/ccgguard live only on Map 109).

completion.condition: Two links, both engine-side: (1) navarro_chris_enlist (intent gate_pass, check=Speech diff 4 = the vanilla mod -10) calls exec_proc ccchris:Node997 on a successful roll — that node sets mvar0=1 itself and pays a one-shot 1500 XP; (2) navarro_gate_password (intent gate_pass, check=none — vanilla does not roll for the password) writes setmapvar=14:2 under the guard mvar0==1 AND mvar14==0 AND gvar511==0 AND party_size(0)==0 (whitelist kAtomEffectMapVars). The party gate 'recruits report ALONE' ({125}/{132}) rides on the ENGINE scalar atom_party_size (emitAtomPartySize, the exact Node006/008 formula: PARTY_COUNT − car(gvar18) − dude − K-9 pid 16777687); with no data the brain assumes 'not alone' (fail-closed). Dornan then reads mvar0 himself (the vanilla talk_p_proc dispatcher) — our mechanics do not reach in there.
completion.sets: mvar0=1 (Chris, through Node997) | mvar14=2 (the sentry, setmapvar) | 511 — READ ONLY (the alert is written by vanilla)

reward.xp_source: CCCHRIS Node997 one-shot (lvar10==0): give_exp_points(1500) + display {800} 'You conned Chris to give you the password.' — the NODE pays it, not our layer.
reward.notes: Nothing beyond the vanilla 1500 XP for conning Chris. anti-invention: no rewards or items for getting through the gate.

anti_invention: The brain NEVER writes mvar0 — the sole writer is CCCHRIS Node997 (the atom calls it with exec_proc); mvar14 is written ONLY as setmapvar=14:2 from the sentry atom (whitelist), and gvar511 is read-only.
Chris's Speech check is a REAL engine roll; on a failure the model voices the fail_line — never a «ладно, проходи».
Vanilla does NOT roll for the password at the sentry — but «уговорить без пароля» does not exist either: without mvar0==1 the atom is dead and the refusal is honest.
The party gate is engine arithmetic (atom_party_size), NOT perceived names: with a retinue the sentry atom does not fire and the NPC refuses in canon ({125}/{132}).
A gatekeeper has no right to let the player past or accept the password in words until the real node/effect has run (the gatekeeper-grounding class; ECBridge is the same class).
